title: Negative comparison weights can distort
hook: Two stated cases: explore the weighted-effect arithmetic behind problematic comparisons.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the weighted-effect arithmetic behind problematic comparisons affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Contrast, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the weighted-effect arithmetic behind problematic comparisons in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
